newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Solid Energy Huntly coal mine to remain open.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Solid Energy Huntly coal mine to remain open.

text.p: Solid Energy's Huntly East coal mine will remain open following a productivity agreement with workers, the state-owned company's national services manager John Ryan said on Tuesday.
Failure to reach agreement with workers last week forced Solid Energy to announce the closure of Huntly East.
But after meeting with worker representatives in Wellington on Monday, Ryan said there was a "real conviction" to meet targets.
Solid Energy is also involved in a capital expenditure programme to achieve that aim, Ryan told Reuters.
The agreement involves increasing annual production to 450,000 tonnes over the course of two years, from the current 300,000 tonnes.
The agreement was aimed at raising productivity by increasing hours of work along with pay, but cutting out overtime, and through the introduction of production targets.
The Huntly East mine has one major customer -- the Glenbrook Steel mill. Glenbrook, which is owned by The Broken Hill Pty Ltd, itself faces closure if it fails to cut costs and improve productivity.
